title: Yamba My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible ya bwereere eri buli muntu, emirembe gyonna. Bw’ekuyamba, osobola okuyamba ettaala okusigala ng’eyaka.
sub: Ya bwereere eri buli muntu, emirembe gyonna. Bw’ekuyamba, osobola okuyamba ettaala okusigala ng’eyaka.
kofiSub: Omulundi gumu, oba buli mwezi. Ne kaadi, Apple Pay oba Google Pay, tekyetaagisa kwewandiisa.
leave: Eggukira ku lupapula olupya. Bw’omala, komawo wano, oba ku Baibuli.
btcSub: On-chain oba Lightning, butereevu ku server yaffe, awatali muntu wa wakati oba omulala yenna.
where:
• Ma server agakuuma okukwataganya n’ebibinja nga bikola.
  • Amannya ga domain, myquietbible.com esobole okweyongera okukola.
  • Email eweereza koodi z’okuyingira.
never: Tewali kintu mu Baibuli kijja kusibibwa. Okuwaayo kwebaza, si kkubo lya kuyingira, era tewali kikyuka mu app ka owaayo oba towaayo.
tax: My Quiet Bible si kitongole kya buyambi ekiwandiisiddwa, n’olwekyo ebirabo tebisobola kukendeeza ku musolo gwo.
other:
• Sabira omulimu guno, n’abantu abagusomeramu.
  • Weereza myquietbible.com eri omuntu ayagala Baibuli ey’emirembe.
